reason: A bundled DSH agent skill for researching Xiaohongshu trends, selecting topics, generating or rewriting promotional notes, checking claims, analyzing authorized accounts, and optionally preparing or publishing content with human confirmation; deep research is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于研究小红书热门内容、选择选题、生成或改写种草笔记，并在授权和人工确认下支持账号分析及受控发布。
summaries.en: A DSH agent skill for researching Xiaohongshu trends, selecting topics, generating or rewriting promotional notes, and supporting authorized account analysis and controlled publishing with human confirmation.

capabilities: Researches Xiaohongshu topics and public trend information
Generates and rewrites Xiaohongshu promotional notes
Performs compliance checks and claim tracking
Runs bundled scripts and CLI tools through the host shell
Supports QR login and authorized account analysis
Supports controlled draft and publishing workflows with human confirmation
